name: HiveDash
description: HiveDash automatically discovers services from Nginx Proxy Manager and Proxmox VE, matching a Proxmox guest to its NPM proxy host by IP or hostname and merging them into one live-updating tile instead of listing both separately. Supports admin-curated dashboards with categories, drag-and-drop ordering, adjustable tile size, a logo library with automatic icon matching against the dashboard-icons catalog, and manually-added services that have no NPM/Proxmox counterpart at all.

notes.text: Nothing is discovered until you edit /opt/hivedash_data/hivedash.env with your Nginx Proxy Manager and Proxmox VE credentials, then run: systemctl restart hivedash
The generated bootstrap admin password is shown once at the end of the install and saved in /opt/hivedash_data/hivedash.env - save it somewhere safe.
The SQLite database and generated config live in /opt/hivedash_data, outside the app directory, so they survive updates.
